entries.msgstr: These are special boxes containing new and unique items, including Premium vehicles, 2D styles, credits, and more.
Warm Spring Supply Boxes Temporarily Unavailable

Every %(guaranteed0)s Warm Spring Supply Boxes is guaranteed to contain a Tier VIII–IX vehicle. If you open them without one dropping such a vehicle, then a Tier VIII–IX vehicle you do not already own will drop when you open the %(guaranteed0)sth box (depending on the box type). When it does, the counter is reset.
